item.title: Top lawyer jailed for drink driving will not be disbarred
item.description: A PROMINENT Jersey lawyer who was jailed last year for drink driving will be suspended from his profession until the end of this year – but will not be disbarred. item.title: Community fishing project transforms disused lake
item.description: AN abandoned lake in St Lawrence is being brought back to life through a community fishing project. item.description: JERSEY’S leading darts players will head to Ireland this weekend for the fourth and final staging of the Islands International Darts competition. item.title: Government sale of apartments in building with “historic issue” criticised by property manager
item.description: The government has been accused of selling more than a dozen St Clement flats without warning the buyers of known defects with the building. Gary Bryant, the property manager of the Maison D’Azette block, hit out at the government for selling the freeholds within the building despite knowing about a long-standing problem with its exterior. item.description: THE not-for-profit organisation selected to take the lead of the regeneration of the empty Les Creux Pavilion has said it is “delighted” to become the preferred tenant. item.description: PROPOSED new animal welfare laws affecting pet owners and livestock keepers received unanimous support in the States yesterday. Environment Minister Steve Luce brought forward a new draft law, saying that there was widespread recognition that the Island’s existing law, enacted in 2004, was no longer adequate. item.description: THE police will request additional detectives to tackle technological advances in crime and ensure proposed new legislation to tackle violence against women and girls is adequately resourced, a senior officer has said. item.title: ‘Unprecedented demand’ on States police as new laws pile on pressure
item.description: STATES police are facing an “unprecedented” surge in demand while staring down the prospect of shrinking resources, according to a senior officer.
